decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-0f1afb29729f], is a one-line CLI changelog title. It does not say which update mechanism now skips release candidates (a CLI version check, a bootstrap/install path, or something else). It also gives no before/after behaviour. "protocol-behavior" (wire behaviour such as TLS or signing) is not supported as the family, and the name just copies the title, so the subject's identity and the change type cannot be confirmed. The PR #5507 description or diff would be needed to show which command or code path changed and how.
